title: Blueprint
line: A technical drawing: mono type on drafting blue, signal yellow, outlines that fill in.
line_zh: 一张技术图纸：制图蓝上的等宽字，信号黄，先描边再填色。
prompt: Blueprint style: mono type on drafting blue, pale blue-white ink and one signal yellow, fine ruled lines, outline-then-fill and typewriter type, slices and mask reveals, a tech pulse bed with pen clicks and a scan sweep.
prompt_zh: 蓝图风格：制图蓝底上的等宽字，淡蓝白墨色与一抹信号黄，细密的格线，先描边后填色与打字机字效，切片与遮罩揭示转场，科技律动配乐，配笔尖点击与扫描声。
essence: The film is drawn, not shot: lines are measured, type is set like annotation and every reveal is a part being specified. Precision is the mood.

not.difference: Swiss Grid is black sans on white; Blueprint is mono annotation on drafting blue.
Retro CRT is a glowing screen with scanline noise; Blueprint is a clean drawing with no glow.

palette.logic: drafting blue ground, pale blue-white ink, ONE signal yellow for the measured value

camera.expresses: following a line across the drawing
zooming into a detail of the drawing

sound.foley: pen clicks, a drawn highlight and a scan sweep

signature_features.text: pale ink on drafting blue at 12:1, signal yellow at 9.7:1 (contrast.py)
a mono face set upper-case, outline then fill
window slices, luma wipes and mask reveals only
a tech pulse bed with drawing sounds
fine ruled lines read as a drawing sheet, not as scanlines

demo.lint: mp lint 99.0/100, 54 PASS, 2 WARN, 0 FAIL, 0 INFO, 13 N/A

honesty: The demo is one run on a neutral placeholder subject (a fictional late-night library, labelled placeholder). The same prompt makes a different film on every run.
